questions.question: Evaluate: (5^(1)/(4)) times (125⁰.²⁵)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert terms to the same prime base: 125 = 5³ and 0.25 = 1/4

⇒ 5¹/⁴ × (5³)¹/⁴

⇒ 5¹/⁴ × 5³/⁴ = 5⁽¹/⁴ ⁺ ³/⁴⁾

⇒ 5¹ = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 5¹/⁴ × 125⁰.²⁵

**Formula Used:**

am × bm = (a × b)m

**Calculation:**

⇒ Since 1/4 = 0.25, the expression can be written as:

⇒ 5⁰.²⁵ × 125⁰.²⁵

⇒ Applying the formula am × bm = (a × b)m:

⇒ (5 × 125)⁰.²⁵

⇒ 625⁰.²⁵

⇒ Converting the decimal power back to a fraction (0.25 = 1/4):

⇒ 625¹/⁴

⇒ We know that 625 = 5 × 5 × 5 × 5 = 5⁴

⇒ (5⁴)¹/⁴

⇒ 5⁴ × ⁽¹/⁴⁾

⇒ 5¹ = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule of Indices

When multiplying terms with the same base, add their exponents: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

Power of a Power Rule

When raising a power to another power, multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = amⁿ

Power of a Product Rule

When multiplying terms with the same exponent, multiply their bases: am × bm = (a × b)m

questions.question: In an election, the winner gets 80% of the total valid votes. If 18% are invalid votes out of 2,00,000 votes, then the votes polled in favour of the winner are:6491

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 6 and 2 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(3, 6, 2) = 6 units.

Combined efficiency = (6 ÷ 3) + (6 ÷ 6) + (6 ÷ 2) = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 units/day.

Target work = 2 × Total work = 2 × 6 = 12 units.

Time required = Target work ÷ Combined efficiency = 12 ÷ 6 = 2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 6 days

Time taken by C = 2 days

Target work = 2 × Original work

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total original work = 6 units

⇒ Target work = 2 × 6 = 12 units

⇒ Total combined efficiency (A + B + C) = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 units/day

⇒ Time taken = Target work ÷ Total efficiency = 12 ÷ 6 = 2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Operates on the same principle as time and work. An inlet pipe has positive efficiency (+), while an outlet pipe (leakage) has negative efficiency (−).

Work and Wages

Wages are directly proportional to the total amount of work done by each person. If everyone works for the exact same number of days, wages are distributed purely in the ratio of their individual efficiencies.

Alternate Days Work

When individuals work one at a time on alternate days, find the combined work completed in one full cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and multiply it up to reach the highest multiple below the total work.

questions.question: Walking at (3)/(4) of his normal speed from his home, Abhishek is 30 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time ∝ 1/Speed ⇒ new time = 4/3 of normal time

Delay = (4/3 − 1) = 1/3 of normal time

1/3 of time = 30 minutes

Normal time = 30 × 3 = 90 minutes

**∴ Answer = 90 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New speed = 3/4 of normal speed

Delay = 30 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed ⇒ Time ∝ 1/Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = t

⇒ New time = t × (4/3)

⇒ Delay = (4/3)t − t

⇒ Delay = t/3

⇒ t/3 = 30

⇒ t = 90 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 90 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

For fixed distance, time is inversely proportional to speed.

Speed Fraction Rule

If speed becomes a/b, time becomes b/a times.

Delay Concept

Extra time taken = New time − Original time.

questions.question: For 5 innings, a cricketer has an average of 80 runs. In the 6th inning, he scores 194 runs. His average score increased by _______.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Current average of 5 innings = 80 runs.

Runs scored in the 6th inning = 194.

Extra runs scored above the current average = 194 − 80 = 114 runs.

These extra runs will be distributed equally among all 6 innings.

Increase in average = 114 ÷ 6 = 19 runs.

**∴ The correct answer is 19 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average score for 5 innings = 80 runs

Score in the 6th inning = 194 runs

 Innings 1 to 5 Average = 80 6th Inning Base = 80 Extra = +114 
 
 Distributed over 6 innings = +19 New Average = 80 + 19 = 99 

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total sum of values ÷ Total number of values

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs in the first 5 innings = 5 × 80 = 400 runs

⇒ Total runs after the 6th inning = 400 + 194 = 594 runs

⇒ New average after 6 innings = 594 ÷ 6 = 99 runs

⇒ Increase in average = New average − Old average

⇒ Increase in average = 99 − 80 = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method

If a new value added is greater than the current average, the overall average increases. The exact increase is calculated as: Increase = (New Value − Old Average) ÷ New Total Number of Observations.

Combined Average

When combining two separate groups, the Combined Average is calculated as (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the number of items and A is their respective group average.

Weighted Average

Similar to the combined average, it assigns a specific weight (w) to each value (x), and the final result is calculated as ∑(w × x) ÷ ∑w.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹7,300 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the successive percentage formula, the effective compound interest rate for 2 years at 10% per annum is:

Effective CI rate = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) ÷ 100 = 21%

The total amount becomes 100% (Principal) + 21% (Interest) = 121% of the principal.

Amount = 121% of ₹7,300 = (121 ÷ 100) × 7300

Amount = 121 × 73 = ₹8,833

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,833.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,300

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R / 100)T

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 10%, 45% and 55% in three successive months, but increases by 55% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use successive multiplier method

Final factor = (0.90) × (0.55) × (0.45) × (1.55)

0.90 × 0.55 = 0.495

0.495 × 0.45 = 0.22275

0.22275 × 1.55 = 0.34526

Net change = 0.34526 − 1 = −0.65474 = −65.47%

**∴ Answer = 65.47% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −10%, −45%, −55%, +55%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 ± percentage/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original price = 100

⇒ After 1st month = 100 × 0.90 = 90

⇒ After 2nd month = 90 × 0.55 = 49.5

⇒ After 3rd month = 49.5 × 0.45 = 22.275

⇒ After 4th month = 22.275 × 1.55 = 34.52625

⇒ Net change = 34.52625 − 100 = −65.47375

⇒ Percentage change ≈ −65.47%

**∴ The correct answer is 65.47% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

Overall multiplier = (1 ± a/100)(1 ± b/100)... for multiple changes.

Net Percentage Change

Net % change = (Final − Original)/Original × 100.

Important Concept

Successive decreases and increases must always be multiplied, not added.

questions.question: Find the HCF of the numbers 4220, 5440 and 6880.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide all numbers by common factor step-by-step

4220, 5440, 6880 are all divisible by 20

⇒ 211, 272, 344

Now HCF of 211, 272, 344 = 1

So HCF = 20

**∴ Answer = 20**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 4220, 5440, 6880

**Formula used:**

HCF by prime factorization method

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4220 = 2 × 2 × 5 × 211

⇒ 5440 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 17

⇒ 6880 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 5 × 43

⇒ Common factors = 2 × 2 × 5

⇒ HCF = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF Concept

HCF is the greatest number that divides all given numbers exactly.

Prime Factorization

Break numbers into prime factors and multiply common primes.

Division Method

Repeated division by common numbers helps quickly find HCF.

questions.question: Radha has ₹10 and ₹5 coins. She has a total of 15 coins worth ₹85. How many coins of ₹5 does she have?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all coins are ₹5 ⇒ total = 15 × 5 = 75

Extra needed = 85 − 75 = 10

Each ₹10 coin gives extra ₹5

Number of ₹10 coins = 10 ÷ 5 = 2

₹5 coins = 15 − 2 = 13

**∴ Answer = 13**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total coins = 15, Total value = 85

Coins are of ₹10 and ₹5

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number of ₹10 coins = x

⇒ Number of ₹5 coins = 15 − x

⇒ Total value = 10x + 5(15 − x)

⇒ 10x + 75 − 5x = 85

⇒ 5x = 10

⇒ x = 2

⇒ ₹5 coins = 15 − 2 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Type Logic

Assume all items as one type, then adjust using difference method.

Linear Equation Method

Use variables to form equations based on total number and value.

Check Method

Verify by substituting values back into total sum.

questions.question: A water tank can be filled in 13 minutes using 46 identical pipes. How long (in minutes) will it take to fill the same tank if only 27 such pipes are used? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time ∝ 1 / number of pipes

New time = Old time × (Old pipes ÷ New pipes)

= 13 × (46 ÷ 27)

= 598 ÷ 27 ≈ 22.15 minutes

**∴ Answer = 22.15 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

46 pipes fill tank in 13 minutes

Required: time taken by 27 pipes

**Formula used:**

Time × Number of pipes = Constant work

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 46 × 13 = 598 pipe-minutes

⇒ Time with 27 pipes = 598 ÷ 27

⇒ Time ≈ 22.15 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 22.15 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

Time and number of pipes are inversely proportional.

Work Formula

Work = Rate × Time. Here rate depends on number of pipes.

Pipe Concept

More pipes reduce time proportionally for same work.

questions.question: A cylindrical pillar has a diameter of 10 cm and a height of 35 cm. The curved surface is to be painted at a cost of ₹12/cm². If a 10% discount is offered on the total painting cost, how much will be paid? (Use π = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius = 5 cm, Height = 35 cm

CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 5 × 35 = 1100 cm²

Cost before discount = 1100 × 12 = 13200

After 10% discount ⇒ pay 90% ⇒ 13200 × 0.9

= 11880

**∴ Answer = 11880**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter = 10 cm ⇒ Radius = 5 cm, Height = 35 cm

Cost = ₹12/cm², Discount = 10%

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 5 × 35

⇒ CSA = 1100 cm²

⇒ Total cost = 1100 × 12 = 13200

⇒ Discount = 10% of 13200 = 1320

⇒ Final cost = 13200 − 1320 = 11880

**∴ The correct answer is 11880.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

CSA = 2πrh, where r is radius and h is height.

Discount Formula

Final Price = Original Price × (1 − Discount/100).

Unit Consistency

Ensure area is in cm² before multiplying with cost per cm².

questions.question: Raj’s monthly income is ₹50,000. He spends 40% of his income on household expenses and saves the remaining amount. If his income increases by 10%, and his expenditure on household expenses remains the same percentage of his income, calculate the amount (in ₹) he saves after the increment.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income increases by 10% ⇒ new income = 50000 × 1.10 = 55000

Expenditure = 40% ⇒ savings = 60%

New savings = 60% of 55000

= 0.6 × 55000 = 33000

**∴ Answer = 33000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Original income = 50000, Expenditure = 40%

Income increases by 10%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income × (1 − Expenditure%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ New income = 50000 × (1 + 10/100)

⇒ New income = 50000 × 1.10 = 55000

⇒ Savings% = 100 − 40 = 60%

⇒ Savings = 55000 × 60/100

⇒ Savings = 33000

**∴ The correct answer is 33000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Savings Formula

Savings = Income − Expenditure or Income × (1 − expense%).

Percentage Increase

New value = Original × (1 + increase/100).

Complement Rule

If expenditure is 40%, savings automatically become 60%.

questions.question: A total profit of ₹13,800 is to be distributed amongst A, B and C such that A : B = 20 : 2 and B : C = 1 : 4. The share (in ₹) of B in the profit is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Make B common in both ratios

A : B = 20 : 2 ⇒ 10 : 1

B : C = 1 : 4

Combine ⇒ A : B : C = 10 : 1 : 4

Total parts = 15 ⇒ B's share = 1/15 of 13800 = 920

**∴ Answer = 920**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 20 : 2 and B : C = 1 : 4

Total profit = 13800

**Formula used:**

Equalize common term and combine ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 20 : 2 = 10 : 1

⇒ B : C = 1 : 4

⇒ Combined ratio = 10 : 1 : 4

⇒ Total parts = 10 + 1 + 4 = 15

⇒ B's share = (1 ÷ 15) × 13800

⇒ B's share = 920

**∴ The correct answer is 920.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combining Ratios

Make the common term equal before merging two ratios.

Profit Distribution

Share = (individual ratio ÷ total ratio) × total profit.

Simplification Tip

Always simplify ratios to smallest form for easier calculation.

questions.question: A camp has provisions for 20 pupils for 13 days. In how many days will the same provisions be used up, if the strength of the camp is increased to 65 pupils?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use inverse proportion (more people ⇒ fewer days)

Days = 13 × (20 ÷ 65)

= 260 ÷ 65

= 4 days

**∴ Answer = 4 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20 pupils can consume food in 13 days

Required: days for 65 pupils

**Formula used:**

Total consumption = pupils × days (constant)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = 20 × 13 = 260 pupil-days

⇒ Days for 65 pupils = 260 ÷ 65

⇒ Days = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion

More people consume resources faster, so days decrease.

Man-Days Concept

Total work = number of persons × number of days remains constant.

Quick Trick

Days = (Old persons × Old days) ÷ New persons.

questions.question: Reena is 5 years older than Meena. Eight years ago from now, Reena's age was twice the age of Meena. Find the present age of Reena.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Meena = x ⇒ Reena = x + 5

8 years ago: (x+5−8) = 2(x−8)

x − 3 = 2x − 16

x = 13 ⇒ Reena = 13 + 5 = 18

**∴ Answer = 18 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reena is 5 years older than Meena

8 years ago, Reena = 2 × Meena

**Formula used:**

Present age relations and linear equation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Meena's present age = x

⇒ Reena's present age = x + 5

⇒ 8 years ago: Reena = x + 5 − 8 = x − 3

⇒ 8 years ago: Meena = x − 8

⇒ x − 3 = 2(x − 8)

⇒ x − 3 = 2x − 16

⇒ x = 13

⇒ Reena's present age = 13 + 5 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Relation Concept

Differences in ages remain constant over time.

Linear Equation Method

Form equations based on conditions and solve step-by-step.

Time Shift Rule

Past age = Present age − years.

questions.question:
A shopkeeper declares the following three schemes of discounts. Which scheme is the most beneficial to a customer?

A. Buy 42 items and get 47 of the same items

B. Two successive discounts of 16% and 36%

C. Two successive equal discounts of 46%
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all schemes into equivalent discount

A: Buy 42 get 47 ⇒ total 89 for price of 42 ⇒ discount = 47/89 ≈ 52.81%

B: Net discount = 16 + 36 − (16 × 36)/100 = 52 − 5.76 = 46.24%

C: Net discount = 46 + 46 − (46 × 46)/100 = 92 − 21.16 = 70.84%

Maximum discount is best

**∴ Answer = Scheme C**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three discount schemes A, B, C

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = a + b − (ab/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Scheme A: Pay for 42, get 89

⇒ Effective price ratio = 42/89

⇒ Discount = 1 − 42/89 = 47/89 ≈ 52.81%

⇒ Scheme B: 16% and 36%

⇒ Net discount = 16 + 36 − (16 × 36)/100 = 46.24%

⇒ Scheme C: 46% and 46%

⇒ Net discount = 46 + 46 − (46 × 46)/100 = 70.84%

⇒ Maximum discount = Scheme C

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equivalent Discount

Free items can be converted into percentage discount using ratio method.

Successive Discount Formula

Net discount = a + b − (ab/100).

Comparison Rule

Higher effective discount is always more beneficial to the customer.

questions.question: If the fourth proportional to 8, X and 15 is 135, then find the value of X .4888
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For four numbers in proportion: Product of Extremes = Product of Means

8 × 135 = X × 15

1080 = 15 × X

X = 1080 ÷ 15 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers in proportion are 8, X, 15, and 135.

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a : b = c : d ⇒ a ÷ b = c ÷ d

 
 8

 135

 

 Product of Extremes = 8 × 135

 

 Product of Means = X × 15

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8 ÷ X = 15 ÷ 135

⇒ 8 ÷ X = 1 ÷ 9

⇒ X × 1 = 8 × 9

⇒ X = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fourth Proportional

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a : b :: c : d. Here, d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. Formula: d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion, then a : b :: b : c. Here, c is the third proportional to a and b. Formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the square root of their product. Formula: Mean proportional = √(a × b).
</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is 55.44 { m}² , which is two-thirds of its total surface area. Find the volume of the cylinder correct to two decimal places ({use } pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CSA = (2/3) of TSA ⇒ TSA = (3/2) × 55.44 = 83.16

TSA − CSA = 2πr² ⇒ 83.16 − 55.44 = 27.72

2πr² = 27.72 ⇒ r = 2.1 m

CSA = 2πrh ⇒ 55.44 = 2π × 2.1 × h ⇒ h = 4.2 m

Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × (2.1)² × 4.2 = 58.21

**∴ Answer = 58.21 m³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area = 55.44 m², CSA = (2/3) of TSA

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

CSA = 2πrh, TSA = 2πr(h + r), Volume = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ TSA = (3/2) × 55.44 = 83.16

⇒ 2πr(h + r) − 2πrh = 27.72

⇒ 2πr² = 27.72

⇒ r² = 27.72 ÷ (2π) = 27.72 ÷ (44/7) = 4.41

⇒ r = 2.1 m

⇒ 55.44 = 2πrh

⇒ 55.44 = (44/7) × 2.1 × h

⇒ h = 4.2 m

⇒ Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × 4.41 × 4.2

⇒ Volume = 58.21 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 58.21 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Surface Relation

TSA = CSA + 2πr², useful when relation between CSA and TSA is given.

Volume Formula

Volume = πr²h

Shortcut Insight

When CSA is fraction of TSA, directly isolate r using difference.

questions.question: The length of a rectangular field is (2x + y²) m and breadth is (2x − y²) m. Find the area of the rectangular field when x = 2 and y = 1 .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute the given values x = 2 and y = 1 directly to find length and breadth.

Length = 2(2) + 1² = 4 + 1 = 5 m.

Breadth = 2(2) − 1² = 4 − 1 = 3 m.

Area = Length × Breadth = 5 × 3 = 15 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 15 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (L) = (2x + y²) m

Breadth (B) = (2x − y²) m

x = 2, y = 1

**Formula Used:**

Area of a rectangle = Length × Breadth

Algebraic Identity: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

 Length = 5 m Area = 15 m² Breadth = 3 m 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (2x + y²) × (2x − y²)

⇒ Area = (2x)² − (y²)²

⇒ Area = 4x² − y⁴

Substitute x = 2 and y = 1 into the simplified expression:

⇒ Area = 4(2)² − (1)⁴

⇒ Area = 4(4) − 1

⇒ Area = 16 − 1 = 15 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 15 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area & Perimeter of a Rectangle

The area of a rectangle is the product of its length and breadth. The perimeter is the total length of its boundary, given by P = 2(L + B).

Difference of Squares Identity

The algebraic identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b² is extremely useful for fast calculations when dimensions involve the sum and difference of identical terms.

Square as a Special Rectangle

If the length and breadth of a rectangle are equal, it becomes a square where Area = side² and Perimeter = 4 × side.

questions.question: A train travels at 84.6 km/hr. How many metres will it travel in 20 minutes?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Convert speed directly into metres per minute, then multiply by time to get the answer instantly.

Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = (84.6 × 1000 m / 60 min) × 20 min

⇒ Distance = (84600 / 3) = 28200 m

**∴ The correct answer is 28,200 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of train = 84.6 km/hr

Time = 20 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 
 
 
• 
 

 

 
 
 Distance = ?
 Speed = 84.6 km/hr
 Time = 20 minutes

**Calculations:**

Convert speed into m/s:

⇒ Speed = 84.6 × (5 / 18) m/s

⇒ Speed = 4.7 × 5 = 23.5 m/s

Convert time into seconds:

⇒ Time = 20 × 60 = 1200 seconds

Calculate distance:

⇒ Distance = 23.5 m/s × 1200 s

⇒ Distance = 28200 m

**∴ The correct answer is 28,200 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed Conversion (km/hr to m/s)

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18.

Speed Conversion (m/s to km/hr)

To convert speed from m/s to km/hr, multiply the value by 18/5.

Average Speed Formula

Average speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. When traveling equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2xy) / (x + y).
</p

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of angle R and angle S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and angle STR = 18^circ . If the ratio of angle P to angle Q is 2 : 7 , then what is the difference between the measures of angle Q and angle P ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any quadrilateral, the angle formed by the bisectors of two adjacent angles is exactly half the sum of the remaining two angles.

⇒ ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 2 × 18° = 36°

⇒ Given ∠P : ∠Q = 2 : 7 (Total 9 parts)

⇒ Difference = (7 − 2) ÷ 9 × 36° = 5 × 4° = 20°

**∴ The correct answer is 20°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral PQRS where angle bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at point T.

∠STR = 18°

∠P : ∠Q = 2 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of a quadrilateral = 360°

Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°

 

 
• 
 
• 
 
 T
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 

 18°
 ∠P : ∠Q = 2 : 7

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔTRS, the sum of angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠TSR + ∠TRS + ∠STR = 180°

⇒ Since T is the intersection of angle bisectors of ∠S and ∠R:

⇒ ½∠S + ½∠R + 18° = 180°

⇒ ½(∠S + ∠R) = 180° − 18° = 162°

⇒ ∠S + ∠R = 162° × 2 = 324°

⇒ In quadrilateral PQRS, ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 324° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 360° − 324° = 36°

⇒ Let ∠P = 2x and ∠Q = 7x

⇒ 2x + 7x = 36° → 9x = 36° → x = 4°

⇒ Difference between ∠Q and ∠P = 7x − 2x = 5x

⇒ Difference = 5 × 4° = 20°

**∴ The correct answer is 20°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Bisectors of Adjacent Angles

In any quadrilateral, the angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of two adjacent angles is exactly half the sum of the remaining two angles. For example, ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2.

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of the interior angles of a polygon with n sides is calculated using the formula (n − 2) × 180°. For a quadrilateral (n = 4), this sum is always 360°.

Angle Bisectors of Opposite Angles

If the bisectors of two opposite angles in a quadrilateral intersect, the acute angle formed by their intersection is equal to half the absolute difference of the other two angles.
</p

questions.question: A dealer allowed a 23% discount on an article and was still able to manage a 44% profit. Find the ratio of the cost price to the listed price.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume CP = 100

Profit = 44% ⇒ SP = 144

Discount = 23% ⇒ SP = 77% of MP

MP = 144 ÷ 0.77 = 14400 ÷ 77

Ratio CP : MP = 100 : (14400/77) = 77 : 144

**∴ Answer = 77 : 144**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discount = 23%, Profit = 44%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − Discount/100), SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ SP = 100 × 1.44 = 144

⇒ SP = MP × 77/100

⇒ 144 = MP × 77/100

⇒ MP = (144 × 100) ÷ 77 = 14400/77

⇒ Ratio CP : MP = 100 : (14400/77)

⇒ Multiply by 77 ⇒ 7700 : 14400

⇒ Simplify ⇒ 77 : 144

**∴ The correct answer is 77 : 144.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation Between CP, SP and MP

SP = CP × (1 + profit%) and SP = MP × (1 − discount%).

Assumption Method

Taking CP = 100 simplifies percentage calculations.

Ratio Simplification

Convert ratios into integers by multiplying with common denominator.
